Indian Markets Rebound After Previous Session's Losses

Indian stock markets experienced a rebound in early trading following significant losses in the preceding session. The recovery was influenced by several factors, including elevated oil prices, investor caution ahead of a U.S. Federal Reserve policy decision, and outflows of foreign funds. These elements collectively capped the extent of the rally.
